dale.name: Dale
dale.style: [shouting] [smug] [outraged] — loud, cocky, always sure he's right

design.description: A loud, cocky, raspy American man in his late forties, a sunburnt Florida guy with a slightly nasal bro accent. Overconfident, easily outraged, prone to shouting, hoarse from cheap beer and cigarettes, sounds like he says 'trust me' right before every disaster. Expressive, comedic, mid-pitched baritone, native American English speaker.
design.text: Two hundred fifty dollars?! For a MAILBOX?! Relax. I'll repaint it myself. I watched a video. It's fine. Everything's fine. Hold on... is that mailbox on fire? Okay. That was not in the video.

design.description: A cheerful, syrupy-sweet American woman in her late fifties, a passive-aggressive suburban HOA president. Bright, slightly high-pitched, slightly nasal voice with a gentle Southern lilt, relentlessly polite with an edge of steel underneath, smiling audibly while she delivers bad news. Says 'bless your heart' as an insult. Native American English speaker.
design.text: Good morning, Dale! Your mailbox is Bone. The approved color is Ecru Whisper. Form twenty-seven B. Thirty days before painting. Oh, sweetie. Bless your heart.

earl.name: Earl the Gator
earl.style: [deadpan] [tired] — slow, dry, only to the camera

design.description: A very old, very deep, slow, gravelly Southern American man's voice for a cartoon alligator. Extremely dry deadpan delivery, tired and unbothered like he has seen everything twice, long pauses, low rumbling bass, Florida cracker drawl. Native American English speaker.
design.text: Seventeen years in this pond. Never paid a fine. Grandfathered in. Nobody asked me. Nobody ever asks the alligator. Well. That's Florida.

earl.voice: Sunny Palms HOA — Earl the Gator
